fact: The UN Economic Commission for Africa page says a nationwide Stakeholder Engagement Workshop on 18 April 2025 brought together public, private and civil society actors to identify Burundi's data governance priorities for the National Data Governance Strategy, validated on 7 November 2025 by a workshop presided over by the Vice-Minister of Finance, Budget and Digital Economy, with private sector, academia and civil society participating in the process.
